propositions: compact.py (798 LOC) bundles three unrelated responsibilities—compaction transaction (_compact_locked, CCN 24), snapshot reconstruction (rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, CCN 21), and CLI surface—blocking refactoring and violating single responsibility

Decompose compact.py into compact_txn.py (transaction + shared snapshot primitives) and compact_rebuild.py (reconstruction engine) while preserving CLI entry points and public import paths via re-export
Shared snapshot helpers (_build_authorship_ledger, _snapshot_strip_keys, _git_author, _git) must live in compact_txn.py to avoid circular imports between txn and rebuild engines

Rebuild counter (_REBUILD_COUNT, get_rebuild_count) must co-locate with rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log in compact_rebuild.py because the function uses global _REBUILD_COUNT; reading from facade would read zero
Two test monkeypatch seams in test_compact_negative.py patch _git and lock on the compact module object and must be repointed to compact_txn._git and compact._lock after decomposition

All complexity-baseline.json entries for compact.py must shrink or drop (ratchet enforces shrink-only after split reduces both _compact_locked and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log below reporting thresholds)
